#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class TaskC {
public:
    int cv, ck, cs;
    vector<vector<int>> freq;
    vector<int> pos[3];
    vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp;

    int dfs(int tv, int tk, int ts, int last) {
        if (tv == cv && tk == ck && ts == cs) return 0;
        if (dp[tv][tk][ts][last] != -1) return dp[tv][tk][ts][last];
        int ret = 1 << 29;
        if (tv < cv) {
            int p = pos[0][tv];
            int move = max(freq[p][0] - tv, 0) + max(freq[p][1] - tk, 0) + max(freq[p][2] - ts, 0) - 1;
            ret = min(ret, dfs(tv + 1, tk, ts, 0) + move);
        }
        if (tk < ck && last != 0) {
            int p = pos[1][tk];
            int move = max(freq[p][0] - tv, 0) + max(freq[p][1] - tk, 0) + max(freq[p][2] - ts, 0) - 1;
            ret = min(ret, dfs(tv, tk + 1, ts, 1) + move);
        }
        if (ts < cs) {
            int p = pos[2][ts];
            int move = max(freq[p][0] - tv, 0) + max(freq[p][1] - tk, 0) + max(freq[p][2] - ts, 0) - 1;
            ret = min(ret, dfs(tv, tk, ts + 1, 2) + move);
        }
        return dp[tv][tk][ts][last] = ret;
    }

    void solve() {
        int n;
        string s;
        cin >> n >> s;
        cv = ck = cs = 0;
        freq.assign(n + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) pos[i].clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            freq[i + 1] = freq[i];
            char x = s[i];
            if (x == 'V') {
                freq[i + 1][0]++;
                cv++;
                pos[0].push_back(i + 1);
            } else if (x == 'K') {
                freq[i + 1][1]++;
                ck++;
                pos[1].push_back(i + 1);
            } else {
                freq[i + 1][2]++;
                cs++;
                pos[2].push_back(i + 1);
            }
        }
        dp.assign(cv + 1, vector<vector<vector<int>>>(ck + 1, vector<vector<int>>(cs + 1, vector<int>(3, -1))));
        cout << dfs(0, 0, 0, 2) << endl;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    cout.tie(NULL);
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve();
    return 0;
}
